trailhead.label: the Nassfeld pass (1,530 m) on the border, the board’s start

cautions: About 2 km of the ridge path is graded by OpenStreetMap as demanding mountain hiking (T3): rocky and steeper in places, for sure-footed walkers and dogs; no exposed or fixed-rope sections are mapped.
The ridge is open and high: turn back if a storm builds, and carry water as none is mapped on the walk.
Cattle may graze the alpine pastures in summer: short lead, give the herd room.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
